title: OmniTensor control request version 1
description: One request frame on the control socket. The transport is length-prefixed msgpack over a per-user unix-domain socket; this schema describes the decoded map. The envelope carries routing only — an id to correlate the reply and a method name — while the document a method actually accepts travels in params and is validated by that method's own wire schema, so the envelope never has to change when a method's body does.

version.description: Version of the envelope, not of any method's body.

id.description: Caller-chosen correlation value, echoed verbatim in the reply. Scoped to one connection, so reuse across connections is harmless.

method.description: Which runtime method to dispatch. The set a live service exports is announced by describe-contract, not pinned here, so an envelope validator does not have to change when a method is added.

params.description: The method's request document, exactly as its own wire schema defines it; empty for methods that take no request.
